in_sanskrit.name: Bhāvitā
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who brings existence or manifests things. This name is derived from the Sanskrit root word भाव (bhāva) meaning 'to be', 'to exist', 'to become', 'to happen', or 'to manifest'. The suffix इत (it) in Bhavitha denotes the feminine gender.

in_marathi.name: Bhavitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhavitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhavitha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Bhava’ which means existence or experience. It is the feminine form of Bhava, which is a fundamental concept in Hindu philosophy representing the manifestation or experience of the divine. This name symbolizes the divine feminine and the power of creation.
